cuerpo.name: LNReader Plugins v2.0.0
cuerpo.body:
## Features & Improvement
* Minimum the host branch by @nyagami in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader-sources/pull/751
* Beta phase by @nyagami in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader-sources/pull/801
* Count plugins by @nyagami in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader-sources/pull/839
* Feat: protobuf support by @nyagami in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader-sources/pull/831
## Plugins 
* Add novel.ovh by @Rider21 in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader-sources/pull/756
* Added Brazilian Portuguese E-Novel by @felipebonfim2006 in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader-sources/pull/758
* Add faqwiki.us source by @MoonGoblinDev in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader-sources/pull/791
* Add storyseedling.com source by @rexlNico in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader-sources/pull/798
* Added neobook plugin by @Rider21 in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader-sources/pull/803
* Plugin Novelki by @Hayanek in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader-sources/pull/813
* Madara rework & Lightnovelwp update by @error7404 in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader-sources/pull/819
* royalroad & pawread take 2 by @K1ngfish3r in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader-sources/pull/823
* Migrate Japanese and Chinese plugins by @nyagami in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader-sources/pull/838
* Indonesian sources by @K1ngfish3r in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader-sources/pull/836
## Fixes
* More default headers by @nyagami in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader-sources/pull/749
* update releaseTime format by @nyagami in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader-sources/pull/748
* Genesis date fix by @NaddH1 in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader-sources/pull/767
* Fix faqwiki.us chapter parsing  (master branch ) by @MoonGoblinDev in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader-sources/pull/795
* Novelki Date, Status, Summary, Error fix by @Hayanek in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader-sources/pull/817
* lightnovelpub, lightnovelworld fix: replaced ; with + by @CD-Z in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader-sources/pull/818
* (src update) pawread by @K1ngfish3r in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader-sources/pull/826
* fix: kolnovel by @nyagami in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader-sources/pull/833
* (src updates) pawread by @K1ngfish3r in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader-sources/pull/829
## New Contributors
* @rexlNico made their first contribution in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader-sources/pull/798
* @Hayanek made their first contribution in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader-sources/pull/813
* @CD-Z made their first contribution in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader-sources/pull/818

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader-sources/compare/v1.0.0...v2.0.0
